findings.title: `landed` is a second 'story finished' rule outside policy.ts
findings.detail:
policy.ts's header says rules that decide and the inbox both read are defined once there. `landed` (mergedIntoBase || spec.md status done) lives only in inbox/items.ts, while decide uses mergedIntoBase/storyFinished. Today it is used only by the inbox, so it does not diverge yet.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move it to policy.ts next to roundFinished if decide ever needs it; optional.

findings.title: AC3 is tested on the story workflow, not a triage round
findings.detail:
AC3 says 'a finished triage round whose explore reported story'. The test puts last_outcome {step: explore, outcome: story} on STORY_WF. That covers the behaviour (the item never reads last_outcome), but not the literal fixture.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: build the fixture on a triage workflow.
